receipt.convention: DT4N-L1 | y point-wise nghiem ngat: y[t]=1 <=> inject_tick < t <= revert_tick (suy ra tu: rate[t] do khoang (t-1,t] va inject chay trong on_tick SAU khi snapshot tick da flush). Goc thoi gian: t0_mono cua collector; event t_rel LA CHINH bien t_rel cua snapshot cung tick -> khop dong ho la dang thuc, khong phai sai so. Chi so CHINH: point-wise tren moi tick sau warmup, KHONG loai tick chuyen tiep. Chi so PHU (do nhay): loai dai chuyen tiep onset=2, recovery=2 tick. Grace KHONG nam trong y. Point-adjust KHONG duoc dung lam chi so chinh (Kim et al., AAAI 2022).
receipt.convention_stamped_at_collection: point-wise; label[t]=1 iff inject_tick < t <= revert_tick; grace=2 ticks
receipt.clock_source: collector t0_mono (time.monotonic tai luc bat dau ghi); event t_rel LA CHINH bien t_rel cua snapshot cung tick, duoc dong dau trong on_tick SAU khi snapshot da flush
receipt.interpretation: Nhan la INTERVENTION LABEL: "toi da gay loi trong khoang nay". No KHONG bao dam loi gay hau qua do duoc — xem max_separation tung run de phan tich loi o Phase 6. Base rate ~27% la DO THIET KE; Precision phu thuoc base rate khi giu TPR/FPR co dinh; domain shift co the doi TPR/FPR. z=5 la nguong chan doan, khong phai kiem dinh 5-sigma.
